coach_says: You're fresh (TSB +30.9, readiness 75) but Garmin flags a big aerobic-high shortage alongside excess anaerobic load — so this week's priority is sustained tempo/threshold work, not more sprints. Tuesday stays your committed double hard day, with a second quality block Thursday in the best weather of the week; the wet weekend pushes the long ride indoors and Sunday becomes recovery. On the MTB group ride, ride hard but resist repeated all-out sprint efforts — your anaerobic bucket is already overflowing.

days.session: Workout A — Upper body, core & hip stability
days.details: Lunch session (wet day, indoor). Warm-up: 8 min easy spin bike + band pull-aparts and hip openers. Main: Pull-ups 4x6, DB Bench Press 3x8, Single-Arm DB Row 3x10/side, Pallof Press 3x12/side, Side Plank 3x40s, Copenhagen Plank 3x20s, Glute Bridge 3x12 (light). Rest 90s between sets. Objective: strength stimulus for upper body, trunk and hip stability while keeping legs completely fresh for tomorrow's committed double hard day. No heavy lower-body loading today.

days.session: AM Hills road ride + PM hard MTB group ride
days.details: AM (before work, ~60 min | Primary objective: aerobic-high stimulus | Zone 3-4): Warm-up 12 min Z1-2, then ride 4-5 climbs of 5-8 min each at sustained tempo-to-threshold effort (Z3 low Z4, RPE 7), seated and controlled — resist surging over the top. Easy spin descents as recovery. Cool-down 8 min. PM (~90 min): Committed hard MTB group ride — dry conditions, go hard, but cap the number of max-effort sprints; your anaerobic load is already 134 over target, so favour sustained pressure over repeated punches. Fuel well between sessions and prioritise an early night.

Lunch swim, strictly recovery after Tuesday's double. Warmup: 200m easy freestyle, focus on long relaxed strokes. Main set: 4x100m easy (25m drill of choice + 75m smooth swim), 20s rest; then 4x50m easy pull with buoy, 15s rest. Cooldown: 200m very easy mixed strokes. Total: 1000m. Effort throughout RPE 3-4 max — this is blood flow and movement, not fitness. If shoulders or body feel heavy, cut the main set short or swap for 30 min gentle yoga.

Before work, best weather of the week (dry, up to 25°C). Total 60 min | Primary objective: close the aerobic-high gap | Zone 4. Warm-up: 12 min progressive Z1-Z2 with 2x30s builds. Main set: 3x10 min at threshold (Z4, RPE 7-8, hard but controlled — a pace you could hold ~40-60 min fresh), 5 min easy Z1 spinning between reps. Cool-down: 8 min easy. Hold steady power/effort within each rep, no surging. This plus Tuesday's climbs directly targets the -652 aerobic-high shortage.

days.session: Workout B — Posterior chain & single-leg strength
days.details: Lunch session (showery day — gym is the smart choice). Warm-up: 8 min bike + leg swings, bodyweight squats, glute activation. Main: Romanian Deadlift 4x6 (moderate-heavy, crisp form), Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8/side, Single-Leg Hip Thrust 3x10/side, Seated Hamstring Curl 3x8, Standing Calf Raise 3x12, Dead Bug 3x10/side. Rest 2 min on RDLs, 90s elsewhere. Objective: cycling-specific posterior chain and single-leg strength. Keep loads at ~80-85% of usual working weight since tomorrow is a long Z2 ride — solid stimulus, not smashed legs.

Heavy drizzle and gusty wind rule out the road, so take the long ride to the trainer. Total 2h15 | Primary objective: aerobic base volume | Zone 2, conversational pace throughout. No intervals — steady Z2 (RPE 4-5), aiming for consistent power. Optionally include 3x8 min at low cadence (60-65 rpm) at the same Z2 power for muscular endurance without adding intensity. Fuel from the start (60g+ carbs/hour), fan on, and keep it disciplined — this ride must stay easy to preserve the 80/20 balance after two quality days.

Wet and windy — perfect rest day. 40 min gentle yoga/mobility flow: focus on hip flexors, hamstrings, glutes, thoracic spine and lower back after a big riding week. Long holds (60-90s), nasal breathing, nothing strenuous. Otherwise fully switch off, eat well, and get to bed early — sleep history was your weakest readiness factor this week, so bank hours tonight to start next week fresh.
